title: Citations to code sections required.
officialText: In no case shall terms such as “code compliant”, “approved”, “legal” or similar terms be used in the construction documents as a substitute for specific reference to a particular code section, approval or standard in order to show compliance with code requirements or other applicable laws and rules.
